root_cause.text: The `q6apm_lpass_dai_prepare` function in the ASoC Qualcomm LPASS driver fails to verify if the audio graph is already open before attempting to allocate a new one, allowing duplicate resource initialization when the prepare callback is invoked multiple times.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `sound/soc/qcom/qdsp6/q6apm-lpass-dais.c` by adding the condition `&& dai_data->graph[dai->id] == NULL` to the playback stream check before calling `q6apm_graph_open`, and the CVE description explicitly states that "prepare can be called mulitple times" which results in "multiple graph opens" and "memory leaks".

intent_record.how: Prevents duplicate graph opening by checking if a graph has already been initialized for this DAI before attempting to create a new one, avoiding redundant resource allocation and potential errors
